verdict.rationale: Portkey documents a Model Catalog, described as a single pane to view and manage every provider and model, with discovery and usage controls across 1,600+ models. That covers the browse part of the story. The evidence never says the catalog exposes per-model pricing or context-window metadata, and there is no documented API for querying it. missing for 10: per-model pricing metadata, context-window metadata, a documented programmatic catalog query endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
